title: Registry publishing
description: What gets published to the MCP Registry, of which type and by whom, by day, week or month.

options.content: **How to read this.** Every figure comes from the registry's public catalogue, which keeps each published version with the time it was published, so these are exact counts and go back to the start. A version counts in the ${period} it was published, even if it was deleted later. A new server is the first version published under a name. Each version gets one type: its package type, or remote only, or remote and package; the "offers" panel counts every package type and remote separately. Panels marked "today" ignore the time range.

panels.title: How much: the selected time range in total

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Versions" FROM publish_version WHERE $__timeFilter(published_at)

panels.title: New servers
panels.description: Names whose first version was published in the selected range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "New servers" FROM publish_version WHERE first_for_server AND $__timeFilter(published_at)

panels.title: Publishers active
panels.description: Distinct namespaces (the part of a server name before the slash) that published at least one version in the selected range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT namespace) AS "Publishers" FROM publish_version WHERE $__timeFilter(published_at)

panels.title: New publishers
panels.description: Namespaces whose first ever version was published in the selected range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "New publishers" FROM (SELECT namespace, min(published_at) AS first_at FROM publish_version GROUP BY namespace) x WHERE $__timeFilter(first_at)

panels.title: Servers listed today
panels.description: Servers in the catalogue now, not counting deleted ones. Ignores the time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Servers" FROM publish_version WHERE is_latest AND coalesce(status, '') <> 'deleted'

panels.title: Versions listed today
panels.description: Every version in the catalogue now, not counting deleted ones. This is what a client reads when it pages through all versions. Ignores the time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Versions" FROM publish_version WHERE coalesce(status, '') <> 'deleted'

panels.title: Versions published, by ${period}
panels.description: New servers are the first version under a name; the rest are new versions of servers that already existed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT greatest(date_trunc('${period}', published_at, 'UTC'), $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE first_for_server) AS "New servers", count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT first_for_server) AS "New versions of existing servers" FROM publish_version WHERE $__timeFilter(published_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Servers ever published, by ${period}
panels.description: Running count of distinct server names published up to the end of each ${period}. Deleted servers are not taken out.

targets.rawSql: WITH firsts AS (SELECT date_trunc('${period}', published_at, 'UTC') AS bucket, count(*) AS added FROM publish_version WHERE first_for_server GROUP BY 1), running AS (SELECT bucket, sum(added) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS total FROM firsts) SELECT greatest(bucket, $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS time, total AS "Servers ever published" FROM running WHERE bucket >= date_trunc('${period}', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, 'UTC') AND bucket <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz ORDER BY 1

panels.title: New servers by type, by ${period}
panels.description: First versions only, by the one type each was published with.

targets.rawSql: SELECT greatest(date_trunc('${period}', published_at, 'UTC'), $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS time, type_label AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM publish_version WHERE first_for_server AND $__timeFilter(published_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: All versions published by type, by ${period}
panels.description: Every version, including new versions of existing servers, by the one type each was published with.

targets.rawSql: SELECT greatest(date_trunc('${period}', published_at, 'UTC'), $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS time, type_label AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM publish_version WHERE $__timeFilter(published_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Servers listed today, by type
panels.description: The latest version of every server in the catalogue now, by its one type. Ignores the time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT type_label AS "Type", count(*) AS "Servers" FROM publish_version WHERE is_latest AND coalesce(status, '') <> 'deleted' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: What listed servers offer today
panels.description: How many servers in the catalogue now offer each package type or remote. Remote (HTTP) is the streamable HTTP transport. A server that offers several counts in each, so these add up to more than the number of servers. Ignores the time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT offer AS "Offers", count(*) AS "Servers" FROM publish_version, unnest(offers) AS offer WHERE is_latest AND coalesce(status, '') <> 'deleted' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Types: listed today and published in the selected range
panels.description: Listed today counts servers in the catalogue now. New in range counts first versions published in the selected range; All in range counts every version published in it.

targets.rawSql: WITH listed AS (SELECT type_label, count(*) AS servers FROM publish_version WHERE is_latest AND coalesce(status, '') <> 'deleted' GROUP BY 1), ranged AS (SELECT type_label, count(*) AS versions, count(*) FILTER (WHERE first_for_server) AS new_servers FROM publish_version WHERE $__timeFilter(published_at) GROUP BY 1) SELECT type_label AS "Type", l.servers AS "Listed today", 100.0 * l.servers / sum(l.servers) OVER () AS "Share today", r.new_servers AS "New in range", 100.0 * r.new_servers / nullif(sum(r.new_servers) OVER (), 0) AS "Share of new", r.versions AS "All in range" FROM listed l FULL JOIN ranged r USING (type_label) ORDER BY l.servers DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Who publishes, over the selected time range
Most active publishers
panels.description: Namespaces ranked by versions published in the selected range. A namespace is the part of a server name before the slash; it is proved either with a GitHub account or by owning the domain.

targets.rawSql: SELECT namespace AS "Publisher namespace", namespace_kind AS "Proved by", count(*) AS "Versions published", count(DISTINCT name) AS "Servers", count(*) FILTER (WHERE first_for_server) AS "New servers", round(count(*)::numeric / count(DISTINCT name), 1) AS "Versions per server", string_agg(DISTINCT type_label, ', ') AS "Types" FROM publish_version WHERE $__timeFilter(published_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC, 1 LIMIT 50

panels.title: New servers, by how the namespace was proved
panels.description: First versions published in the selected range, by whether the namespace is a GitHub account (io.github.*) or a domain.

targets.rawSql: SELECT namespace_kind AS "Proved by", count(*) AS "New servers" FROM publish_version WHERE first_for_server AND $__timeFilter(published_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: How concentrated publishing is
panels.description: Publishers in the selected range, grouped by how many versions each published.

targets.rawSql: WITH p AS (SELECT namespace, count(*) AS versions FROM publish_version WHERE $__timeFilter(published_at) GROUP BY 1), g AS (SELECT CASE WHEN versions = 1 THEN 1 WHEN versions <= 5 THEN 2 WHEN versions <= 20 THEN 3 WHEN versions <= 100 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS band, count(*) AS publishers, sum(versions) AS versions FROM p GROUP BY 1) SELECT (ARRAY['1 version', '2 to 5 versions', '6 to 20 versions', '21 to 100 versions', 'More than 100 versions'])[band] AS "Published", publishers AS "Publishers", versions AS "Versions", 100.0 * versions / sum(versions) OVER () AS "Share of versions" FROM g ORDER BY band
